phase_name: Reproduce, classify, and remedy test-gate-lock.sh's aggregate-only flake

objectives.description: Re-read test-gate-lock.sh and known-failures.txt before any edit
Reproduce the flake cheaply via --only run, confirm 14/2 and NEW classification
objectives.note: Did NOT reproduce: 3 clean --only attempts (0 failures each) instead of the plan-expected 14/2. Premise moved; recorded via issue-record.sh.

objectives.description: Capture full output of both failing cases from per-suite output files
objectives.note: No failing case output existed to capture (flake did not reproduce). Used a diagnostic instrumented copy instead to measure timing margins.

objectives.description: Diagnose teardown case (3000ms poll window vs CPU contention)
objectives.note: Margins measured generous (500ms/0ms vs 3000ms budget) under today's load; LOAD_SENSITIVE_BASENAMES already fully serializes this suite from siblings within run-all.sh.

objectives.description: Diagnose fail-open case (exit-2 site, filesystem-visibility race vs cross-case pollution)
objectives.note: Could not force-reproduce (rc=0 in all attempts); exit-2 site not directly isolated. Judged most-plausible shared mechanism by code inspection: cross-case pollution via unconfirmed process death.

objectives.description: Settle whether the two cases share one cause or two, with evidence
objectives.note: Judged ONE shared cause (unconfirmed siggroup-process death leaving a cross-case-pollution window) by mechanism inspection; not confirmed by a second live occurrence.

objectives.description: Rule out the fixture itself as the defect
objectives.note: Fixture constructs real state it asserts over (pid file, GATE_LOCK_DIR); not itself the defect.

objectives.description: Discard or confirm the concurrent-sibling-edit speculation
objectives.note: Discarded: suite's REQUIRED_LIBS/fixture copy-list never references update-task-status.sh or its dependency chain; no causal path exists.

objectives.description: Classify each case into one of the four outcome-1 classes with recorded evidence via issue-record.sh
objectives.note: Classified both cases as class (a) ambient-host-state fixture timing. Recorded via issue-record.sh (class ambient-host-state-fixture-timing, resolution fixed_inline).

objectives.description: Apply the remedy the classification dictates (seal fixture / hand off / declare in known-failures.txt)
objectives.note: Added a bounded kill -0 liveness wait on the siggroup child's pid after SIGTERM (asserting ordering/causality rather than widening a poll window), per the established convention. No known-failures.txt row needed (class a/b branch fixes in-suite).

objectives.description: Verify: re-run --only reproduction, confirm clean or EXPECTED, and standalone 16/0
objectives.note: Standalone now 17 passed, 0 failed (new liveness case adds one). Aggregate --only 6-suite run clean (6 passed, 0 failed, 0 NEW) after the fix.
